periodicity: N=30 p=15 q=41   (v_{n+p} = v_n + q for all n >= N)
p*gamma - q*n for n = N .. N+p-1: 30 19 23 27 31 20 24 28 32 21 25 29 18 22 26
so gamma(n) = ceil((41 n + 18) / 15) for all n >= N; exceptions below N: 16(+1)
